heading: Today
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off to sunshine, mixed with clouds. A few stray showers or an isolated thunderstorm possible.  Highs from 70 to 80 north to south.  Winds light, becoming northwest, then more northerly near 10 mph, a few gusts to 20 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any evening clouds or stray showers giving way to clearing.  Valley fog developing later at night.  Lows in the 50s, some 40s in the cooler mountain valleys.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Saturday
text: Some morning valley fog, then mostly sunny and pleasantly cool.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds light, mainly northwest less than 10 mph.
